name: Anata no Soba de Waratte Itai
original_name: あなたの傍で笑っていたい
source:
Main character is a famous surgeon. He meets a girl one day who requires surgery, but who strongly dislikes surgery. Together with a new nurse protagonist begins cautious treatment activities.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名知名外科醫師。一天，他遇見一名需要接受手術、卻極度抗拒手術的少女。主角與一名新來的護理師一起，開始謹慎地為她進行治療。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
